caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

definition.workflowName: Go Fan - explicitly partial native deliveries

intent.goal: Review direct Go module usage and identify actionable improvements to API usage, error handling, configuration, performance or use of available module features.
intent.acceptance: Native Go AST establishes Contains(t, err.Error(), expected, ...) replaced by ErrorContains(t, err, expected, ...) in the same enclosing function with unchanged normalized argument expressions and exact testify imports; direct module eligibility independently proved.

evidence.opportunity: Existing testify assertion calls in three explicitly retained files from selected PR 47252. Other files and selected implementation candidates are not extrapolated.
filters: Retrospective fixed-reference and selected-case assessment; not complete historical repository or workflow output coverage.
Immutable actual merge/first-parent source transitions only; one opportunity is counted in one interval.
Periods without evaluated eligible cases are unknown, never zero workflow delivery.
Original strict acceptance, behavior safeguards, historical executor continuity and authoritative creation receipts remain separate.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-checked original Git commits, trees and source blobs plus bounded public GitHub originals; no target code or network execution.

model.architecture: Goal-specific native interpreter over portable immutable originals; only custody and scheduling are shared.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed keep bar or complete comparable history. Do not interpret selected-case missing periods as deterioration.
